purpose: UX-07/T10: unify the canonical public header compact breakpoint so navigation collapses before intermediate-width collisions.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, section 4.2 and UX-07/T10.
coordination: Team Hub #5469 claim 5786430224. No overlap with Gekta panel #5537 or other active public repair branches.
requiredInvariants: Critical CSS, external header CSS and header interaction JS use one 1100px compact threshold.
At 980/1024/1055/1100 the desktop nav is hidden and the existing native details menu is visible; at 1280 desktop nav is visible.
All visible header interactive controls stay at least 44x44 CSS px, inside the viewport and mutually non-overlapping in RU/EN/ZH.
No whole-document horizontal overflow is introduced.
No Gekta controller, navigation destinations, auth, role, tenant, API, backend, release workflow or acceptance threshold changes.
